metric_contract.canonicalization: sort (timestamp, value) pairs ascending before windows, delta, trend, and anomaly direction
metric_contract.matching: case-insensitive exact structured identity; no substring identity matching

resource_contract.aggregate_policy: single-container bounds may be surfaced at aggregate level; multi-container values remain per-container

semantic_operations.LOG_ANALYSIS: bounded, target-scoped, structured log error summaries only
semantic_operations.COMPARE_REPLICAS: available only when an owner/label-related peer is observable
semantic_operations.RECENT_CHANGE_ANALYSIS: unavailable when immutable snapshots contain no trusted change history
